layoutNote: Layouts and anchor scaling are preview proposals. Real 3D geometry, collisions, visual coherence and map occlusion are unverified until rendered in gallery.
globalConstraints: Only a context hero and one ambient accent; no route or pin occlusion
Decorations are fictional and must not imply real venue features
Opt in to religious or culturally specific contexts; never infer identity
Navigation and focus modes may hide all scene props
Lazy-load only chosen assets; obey reduced motion
